title: Betty and Barney Hill told the Air Force and the psychologist different versions

tellings.quote: Betty and Barney Hill for example telling the Air Force one story and then telling the psychologist another story.

plain: Betty Hill and Barney Hill, a New Hampshire couple who reported a UFO encounter in 1961, are said to have told the Air Force one version of what happened and a psychologist another. A YouTuber and researcher named Chris Ramsay brings this up with Michels as an example, without naming a source. It matters because it would suggest that famous accounts like theirs shifted depending on who was listening.
